_readme: Copy to config.json and fill in the URLs at launch (Nov 24, 07:00 UTC).
Left blank is intentional: today there is no published testnet faucet or gateway.
Secrets never go in this file. Use ${ENV:NAME}; the value is read from the environment at run time.
Nothing here is shared with the vfy Worker, its D1, wrangler.toml or its HMAC/PROVER secrets.
claim:  url + path + bodyTemplate. {wallet} and {did} are substituted. Drop bodyTemplate for a GET faucet.
spend:  url + path + model. Set bearerEnv to the env var holding the gateway API key.
price:  flopPerMillionTokens. 0 means the price is unknown, so only tokens are logged, not FLOP spent.
share:  network.vouchersTotalUrl is optional; set it to log your airdrop share per run.
